relationships.subject: CFA
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that miRNA-22 was significantly increased in the dorsal horn of mice with either inflammatory pain induced by plantar injection of complete Freund's adjuvant (CFA) or neuropathic pain induced by unilateral sciatic nerve chronic constrictive injury (CCI).

relationships.subject: chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Similarly, increased levels of miRNA-22 were observed in the ipsilateral dorsal horn from day 7 to day 21 after CCI surgery

relationships.subject: miRNA-22
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, the increased miRNA-22 binds directly to the Mtf1 promoter to recruit RNA polymerase II and elevate Mtf1 expression.

relationships.subject: miRNA-22
relationships.evidence_quote: Lenti-22-mediated overexpression of miRNA-22 increased the expression level of Mtf1 protein

relationships.subject: miRNA-22
relationships.evidence_quote: Upregulation of miRNA-22 by a mimic (22-mics; Figure 6(e), 6(f)) or Lenti-22 (Figure 6(g), 6(h)) led to a significant elevation of c-Fos expression in naïve mice.

relationships.subject: miRNA-22
relationships.evidence_quote: miRNA-22 contributes to spinal sensitization through its effects on Mtf1

key_findings: Nuclear miRNA-22 is increased in dorsal horn neurons after CFA or CCI and binds the Mtf1 promoter to recruit RNA polymerase II and increase Mtf1 transcription.
Spinal miRNA-22/Mtf1 is necessary and sufficient for mechanical allodynia and heat hyperalgesia, increasing p-ERK1/2, GFAP and c-Fos in the dorsal horn.
novel_terms: nuclear miRNA-22 transcriptional activation of Mtf1
